jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Physical AI)
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native startups building in the physical world, across robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, manufacturing, and civil infrastructure, as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build the hardware itself and want Claude woven into how they design, test, and operate it, and others build the software that engineers everywhere use to design, simulate, test, and scale, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup software and hardware engineering teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own engineering with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the physical world. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to build real things, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and helping mechanical, electrical, and process engineers get the kind of step change that software engineering has had from agentic coding with tools like Claude Code. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your engineering domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable physical AI startups to succeed with Claude. Responsibilities Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential startups building in the physical world, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they design, test, and run their own hardware, working alongside them to push the boundaries of AI in engineering, manufacturing, operations, and more Work hands-on with startup software and hardware teams through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their engineering workflows end to end, from design and simulation through test, production, and operations, so that your guidance fits how real hardware gets built Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, benchmarks grounded in real engineering tasks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example integrating Claude with CAD, simulation, design tools, or industrial automation Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about applying AI to physical systems such as reading drawings, 3D geometry, board layout and routing, GD&T, latency and on-premise constraints, and physical safety, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and startup-focused events Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building You may be a good fit if you have Deep engineering experience in a physical discipline such as mechanical, electrical, aerospace, robotics, semiconductor, manufacturing, or civil engineering, gained by designing, building, or operating real hardware, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how physical things get built 4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, robotics or controls engineer, hardware or systems engineer, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real engineering work in design, simulation, test, or production Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both software and hardware engineering audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from robots to chips to rockets to factories and get up to speed on a new domain quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. cold_email.subject: Interest in Process / Equipment Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Process / Equipment Engineer opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Regulatory Data Manager
jobs.description: Vault RIM process and system is highly dependent on accurate & complete metadata at all levels and there is also ​an increasing amount of data that Health Authorities are requiring to be tracked and submitted.​ The Regulatory Data Coordinator is responsible for driving key & critical activities within the Pfizer RIM system in support of enabling the assessment and subsequent management of new or required changes (system events). They will specifically review all events initiated across the product lifecycle, completing system impact assessments, and creating Activities, Regulatory Objectives, Submissions to enable GRS to take the necessary actions. The Coordinator also ensures that Event Details, Change Items & Label Concepts are associated and have the appropriate details as well as creating the Global Content Plan in readiness for content authoring across the enterprise. The Coordinator will work with the CMC Product strategist(s), labeling leads, Clinical & Country Regulatory Strategists through a mix of strategic and operational support, demanding a detailed understanding of regulatory system structures, product licences & master data as well as the end-to-end regulatory change management experience within & across domains. Job responsibilities: Manage all RIM events and related records, including event and registration details, ensuring structures and relationships accurately reflect product market registrations, align with master data standards, and remain updated in accordance with health authority decisions. Interpret health authority communications, drive appropriate system updates, notify stakeholders as needed, and collaborate with GRS stakeholders, CMC strategists, PGS, and cross-functional teams to understand and fulfill data requirements. Review and approve data change requests, ensuring compliance with data governance standards, policies, and regulatory requirements. Maintain active dossiers throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring ongoing accuracy, completeness, and alignment with health authority decisions. Train and support business users on data quality standards, data management practices, and process management best practices. Identify and implement innovative solutions that improve efficiency and effectiveness while developing and optimizing processes that support products throughout the drug development and commercial lifecycle. Ensure escalations, business processes, and system solutions effectively meet business requirements and stakeholder needs. Drive continuous service improvement by aligning processes, solutions, and capabilities with strategic objectives related to efficiency, quality, and operational excellence. Typical Tasks: Collaborate with business units, IT, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements, support data-related initiatives, lead data review/update meetings, and provide guidance to system users through advanced system knowledge. Ensure timely notifications are sent to relevant stakeholders following data updates and generate reports on data quality, data requests, and other key metrics. Review event information to understand the event's purpose and scope, interpret change items, and ensure appropriate event details are updated to support impact assessments and GPC structure creation. Create event details using the designated wizard, selecting appropriate actions and fields. Generate impact assessment reports to identify affected registrations. Create, verify, and validate activities and related records based on impact assessment reports, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and proper linkage. Facilitate the delivery and approval of Pfizer electronic and paper regulatory submissions through the coordination and execution of CMC components in accordance with submission and national market requirements. Manage submission status and deliverables, identify risks, and partner with regulatory strategists and stakeholders to mitigate risks while maintaining accurate metadata in regulatory workflow and document management systems. Lead or co-lead moderately complex projects and provide guidance to project teams. Manage priorities, meet objectives, and forecast and plan resource requirements, including people, financial, and technology resources, across projects. Apply discipline expertise and technical skills to support departmental objectives and deliver high-quality work. Analyze moderately complex issues and develop effective solutions to address business challenges. Make decisions in non-standard situations while adhering to established policies and procedures. Facilitate team discussions, build consensus, and drive progress toward work team goals through informal leadership. Serve as a subject matter expert in regulatory processes, systems, and procedures while collaborating across matrixed teams and stakeholders. Represent the RIO function and contribute to RIO, GI&PE, and GRS continuous improvement initiatives and projects. Qualifications and skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, or related field 4+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs or Regulatory Operations, with at least 3 years in a data governance, data management, or data quality role. Product lead/support experience, including management of product/registration information in systems E2E global regulatory change management experience, including change initiation, performing impact assessments, submission to HA and management of HA decisions/queries/interactions/commitments Detailed understanding of regulatory system structures and how they are intended to enable regulatory business needs and support compliance Detailed understanding of regulatory SME processes and needs across the lifecycle, e.g. centralized registration procedures, IDMP, CMC, Artwork/Labeling Detailed understanding of GRS roles/responsibilities related to dossier maintenance and submissions Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices. Experience with master data management and data quality improvement. Proven technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn and use new software, regulations and quality standards. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity. Available to apply until: October 29th EOD. cold_email.subject: Interest in Regulatory Data Manager — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Regulatory Data Manager opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is growing fast, and our SOX program needs to keep up. Many of the controls that matter for financial reporting run on engineering systems: who can access production and financial systems, how code changes are reviewed and deployed, and how usage is metered and billed. We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the technology side of our SOX program. You'll work across engineering, security, GRC, Finance, and Internal Audit to design and run IT controls, drive gaps to closure, and make compliance lighter for engineering teams. You’ll also use Claude to automate evidence collection and control testing, so the program scales without more manual work. Responsibilities Own the technology side of the SOX program end-to-end, from planning and control design through evidence, testing, remediation, and year-end reporting Work with engineering teams to design and roll out IT general controls and IT application controls Work with engineering teams to build Claude-based workflows, tools, and dashboards to automate evidence collection, control testing, and monitoring that warns engineering teams about compliance issues before an audit finds them Lead large SOX projects, such as bringing new systems into scope, with clear success criteria, dependencies, and delivery dates Turn control requirements into concrete engineering work with clear scope, owners, and deadlines, and a design that fits how our teams already build and ship Build processes to evaluate new products, systems, and major engineering changes for SOX impact before they ship, so the right controls are in place from the start Build strong working relationships with engineering control owners, help them understand what their controls require, and support them in producing evidence for auditor requests Investigate control failures down to root cause, and drive engineering teams to fix them in time for the fix to be tested Help keep an up-to-date list of the systems, apps, and infrastructure in SOX scope, with an owner named for each control Track system migrations and scope changes, and make sure controls are updated as systems move Build metrics and dashboards on control health, open findings, and remediation progress Give regular updates on program status, risks, and remediation to technical leadership Keep improving the program: simplify control processes, remove manual steps, and raise the share of controls that run cleanly You may be a good fit if you Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, IT audit, or technology compliance, with a focus on SOX and IT general controls Have run or supported a SOX program at a public or pre-IPO company Have used automation or AI tools to make compliance work faster and more reliable Know IT general controls and IT application controls in depth, including access management, change management, and application controls, and how they support financial reporting Have worked closely with external auditors Understand cloud infrastructure and engineering workflows, such as code review, CI/CD, and cloud access, well enough to work through a control design with an engineer Can explain technical risks and control gaps clearly to executives and other non-technical audiences Are comfortable driving outcomes across engineering, finance, and audit teams that don't report to you Strong candidates may also have A background in software, systems, or security engineering Hands-on experience building with Claude Code or other AI tools Experience with automated controls in revenue or order-to-cash systems, such as billing and usage metering Experience with financial systems such as ERP and billing platforms, and the controls around them Experience building or rebuilding a SOX program at a fast-growing company Familiarity with other security and IT frameworks, such as NIST or ISO 27001 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Join Amgen's Mission to Serve Patients At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives everything we do. Amgen fights the world's toughest diseases by harnessing the best of biology and technology. We draw on our scientific expertise to push beyond what is known today and help people live longer, fuller lives. If you are energized by collaboration, continuous learning, and meaningful work, we invite you to join our team and help make an impact. Engineer I – Process Engineering (Biologics Process Equipment) What you will do Reporting to the Senior Engineer/ Team Lead/ Manager, this Process Engineer position is primarily responsible for providing operation and New Product Introduction (NPI) support for ASM1 Process Equipment. This role will serve as a system owner for an assigned portfolio of process-support equipment in ASM for the Process Engineering team in the Facilities & Engineering department, which collaborates with Engineering Support and Maintenance team, to deliver uninterrupted plant operations. This function operates in conjunction with the manufacturing team to ensure the appropriate and timely completion of cGMP maintenance activities with minimum disruption to manufacturing. The scope covers both upstream and downstream process areas, including cell culture and harvest filtration, as well as viral inactivation, purification and drug substance bulk fill. This role will assume the system owner role, taking ownership of various process equipment that are used for manufacturing process or supporting manufacturing process. It will be the technical resource or equipment subject matter expert (SME) for assigned systems to ensure that the equipment operates, function and performs as intended and is maintained in a validated state. Scope of work includes managing, planning and implementation of changes, driving deviation investigations, resolving equipment related process interruptions and development of equipment maintenance program. This role requires highly cross functional interactions with key site functions to ensure success in production and release performance. Individual must be able to effectively communicate and collaborate closely with the team members and various SME to ensure equipment are operational to sustain daily operations, resolve operation challenges and implement effective measures to address the challenges to ensure without compromising on safety and compliance. It offers a broad exposure to all key aspects of GMP manufacturing as well as tactical and strategic teamwork within the extended worldwide engineering network. In addition, it will also provide advance technical support to ensure the readiness of the equipment/ facility for successful introduction of new products in ASM. The role will be a liaison between corporate engineering and site operations in the design and implementation of new equipment and/or equipment modifications. Main Responsibilities : Daily Operations Own the day-to-day engineering support, equipment performance, validated state, maintenance plans and lifecycle actions for an assigned portfolio of ASM1 Process Equipment. Present equipment qualification and equipment related investigations and quality management system records in all site regulatory inspections Subject matter expert for process equipment performance and operation to ensure safety, compliance and sustained operation Effectively communicate and collaborate with cross function stakeholders to address operational challenges and concerns to ensure sustained operation and minimal interruptions to operations activities. Lead equipment investigations of moderate complexity, identify root causes, assess technical options, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and drive approved actions to closure. Effectively communicate to the customers on the subsequent plans, short term, and long-term mitigating actions. Collaborate closely with cross functional SME to implement effective corrective, preventive action and improvements to eliminate or mitigate future recurrence. Ensure operation continuity through asset lifecycle management planning, assess and identify impact to safety, compliance, operational schedule and cost. Perform periodic review and maintain process equipment in validated state. Perform assessment for equipment during new product introduction, change controls and other qualifications activities to ensure equipment are in its validated state. Accountable for deviation/change control associated to process equipment performance. Act as technical owner for assigned deviations and change controls, ensuring accurate technical assessment, timely execution and closure. Final approval remains with designated Engineering and Quality approvers. Own defined equipment-readiness deliverables for NPI and site projects, including qualification support, punch-list closure, maintenance and spare-parts readiness, and system turnover Provide technical guidance to Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality and project teams for assigned equipment and coordinate implementation of agreed technical solutions. Continuous improvements, Innovation and operational sustainability Participate in related AMGEN network forums to determine innovative opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, agility and differentiation. Continuously improve business intelligence capabilities utilizing big data analysis tools to extract, analyze and trend performance data for predictive monitoring and troubleshooting. Actively seek opportunities for continuous improvement to improve efficiencies and differentiation through flexible use of advance technologies and best industry practices. Benchmark equipment performance (e.g., reliability, productivity) and determine improvement plans. Build system and capabilities to drive improvements to equipment reliability and maintenance optimization Periodically review and/or improve equipment safety, maintenance strategy, spare parts, and other continuous improvement opportunities to enhance reliability. Design & Project Engineering: Support the functional lead in providing ASM1 Process Equipment readiness support for NPI, GLAM and Site Projects for Process-Support Equipment Where appropriate, provide engineering advice to commissioning and qualification activities including FAT, SAT, automation checkouts, IQ, OQ, PQ, and asset/preventive maintenance/spare parts creation for new process equipment. cold_email.subject: Interest in Engineer I – Process Engineering (Biologics) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Engineer I – Process Engineering (Biologics) opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: About the Team The DoorDash Air team is bringing drone delivery to reality. About the Role As the Product Manager Airspace & Autonomy for DoorDash Air’s Airspace and Autonomy capabilities, you will own the end-to-end product strategy for the software, services, autonomy, perception, human interfaces and related capabilities required to deploy autonomous drone delivery at scale. You will connect DoorDash’s order and logistics platform with the aircraft, autonomy stack, mission-planning services, UTM capabilities, fleet-management tools, and operator workflows that execute each delivery. You will work closely with the Head of UTM and senior Engineering and Operations leaders to establish the product roadmap, clarify system boundaries, make build-versus-partner decisions, and align technical investment with operational scale and unit economics. You will also coach and mentor engineers to help them understand how their work contributes to the broader vision and enables safe and scalable drone delivery operations. This is not a coordination-only role, nor is it purely an internally facing role. You will already have deep credibility in standards development organizations and will promote best practices to help ensure that DoorDash Air’s software, services and hardware meet technical standards required for regulatory compliance in the U.S. and abroad. You will set the vision, establish priorities, make informed technical and product tradeoffs, and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering an integrated drone delivery system. You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… Own the end-to-end product strategy for DoorDash Air’s safety critical software, services and platform infrastructure. Define the long-term vision, platform architecture, capability roadmap, and investment priorities across aircraft, onboard software, cloud services, operational tooling, and DoorDash platform integrations. Integrate drone delivery into the DoorDash marketplace. Define the incremental technical capabilities required to move from one operator supervising one aircraft toward increasingly autonomous multi-aircraft operations, including exception management, alert prioritization, task allocation, fleet orchestration, remote intervention, and human-autonomy interface design. Define the data strategy for autonomous aviation. Determine which geospatial, terrain, obstacle, weather, airspace, population-risk, connectivity, landing-zone, and operational data layers should be built internally, licensed, sourced through partners, or generated by the fleet. Build UTM and airspace-management capabilities. Lead product requirements for operational-volume generation, strategic and tactical deconfliction, dynamic rerouting, airspace authorization, constraint management, conformance monitoring, and interoperability with UTM service providers and public airspace systems. Lead standards compliance and engagement. Champion compliance with relevant standards — ASTM F3201 (software), F3548 and F3411 (UTM-specific functions) — across the airspace software roadmap and specs. Develop business cases and sequencing recommendations that balance safety, customer experience, operational scalability, engineering effort, deployment speed, and long-term unit economics. Experience operating within or building technology for FAA-regulated environments, including familiarity with any combination of National Airspace System hardware/software/procedures, Part 107, Part 135, Part 108, Part 146, BVLOS operating approvals, UTM or USS services, and evolving autonomous-flight regulations. jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Level 4 Sr Associate Software Engineer: Role Description: The Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software applications and solutions that meet business needs and ensuring the availability and performance of critical systems and applications. This role involves working closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to create high-quality, scalable software solutions and automating operations, monitoring system health, and responding to incidents to minimize downtime. Roles & Responsibilities Develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable software applications that meet business and technical requirements. Contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of front-end applications using React.js (preferred) or equivalent UI frameworks, and back-end services using modern programming languages and cloud technologies. Build intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces following enterprise UX standards and design system guidelines. Develop reusable UI components, integrate RESTful APIs, and optimize application performance for improved user experience. Participate in software design discussions and contribute to technical solutions using modern software engineering best practices. Develop innovative solutions by leveraging Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-assisted development tools. Translate business requirements into high-quality, maintainable, and secure software solutions. Develop and execute unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality and reliability. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects, production issues, and performance bottlenecks. Participate in peer code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards. Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API specifications, deployment guides, and operational procedures. Work closely with cross-functional teams including Product Management, UX/UI Design, QA, Data Engineering, and DevOps to deliver high-quality software solutions. Develop and integrate applications with enterprise platforms, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to integrate machine learning models and AI capabilities into enterprise applications. Support the development and maintenance of MLOps pipelines for model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Deploy and support AI/ML-enabled applications in cloud environments while ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Participate in CI/CD pipeline implementation and automate software build, testing, and deployment processes. Monitor application health, investigate operational issues, and implement improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and availability. Assist in automating operational tasks, monitoring, and incident response to improve system efficiency and reduce manual effort. Stay current with emerging technologies, software engineering practices, cloud services, UI frameworks, and AI advancements, applying them where appropriate to improve products and development processes. Contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning. Basic Qualifications and Experience: Basic Qualifications: Master’s/ Bachelor's degree and 5 - 9 years of Computer Science, IT or related field experience Must-Have Skills Solid foundation in software design and development principles, including object-oriented programming, RESTful APIs, microservices, cloud-native applications, and containerization. Hands-on experience in UI engineering using React.js (preferred) or equivalent modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular or Vue.js, including component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and integration with REST/GraphQL APIs. Strong proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive web design, accessibility (WCAG), and modern UI development best practices. Hands-on experience with full-stack software development using frameworks. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and developing applications using cloud-native services. Understanding of Generative AI concepts, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and AI-assisted application development. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar to improve software development productivity. Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, databases, and third-party APIs. Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Experience developing, testing, debugging, and deploying software applications using Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing Good-to-Have Skills Experience with UI component libraries and design systems such as Material UI (MUI), Ant Design, Fluent UI, or equivalent. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or Datadog. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation). Understanding of secure software development practices, DevSecOps principles, and OWASP security guidelines. Familiarity with UX/UI design principles and collaborating with designers to build intuitive, accessible, and responsive user experiences. .

cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Associate Software Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate Software Engineer opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Sr Associate– Image Analysis & Digital Pathology
jobs.description: Career Category Scientific Job Description Job Description: At Amgen , our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, developing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Associate– Image Analysis & Digital Pathology to join our Computational Imaging and Digital Biomarkers team. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and application of computational pathology and AI/ML methods to support translational research, biomarker discovery, and precision medicine initiatives across therapeutic areas. The candidate will work closely with pathologists, data scientists, translational scientists, and software engineers to build scalable image analysis workflows and generate quantitative insights from complex imaging datasets including whole-slide pathology images and spatial biology platforms. Live – What you will do In this vital role, you will: Develop and apply image analysis, computer vision, and machine learning methods for digital pathology datasets. Design and implement analysis pipelines for whole-slide imaging (WSI), H&E, IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial omics datasets. Build reproducible and scalable workflows using Python and modern ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Perform tissue segmentation, cell phenotyping, feature extraction, and spatial analysis using state-of-the-art computational approaches. Collaborate with pathologists and translational teams to interpret image-derived biomarkers and biological findings. Contribute to evaluation, validation, and benchmarking of image analysis algorithms and workflows. Support deployment and operationalization of computational imaging pipelines in cloud or high-performance computing environments. Stay current with advances in computational pathology, AI/ML, and spatial biology technologies. Win – What we expect of you Basic Qualifications: PhD or MS in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative discipline. Strong background in computer vision, image analysis, and machine learning/deep learning. Demonstrated experience working with biomedical imaging data (pathology preferred). Proven track record in developing, validating, and deploying advanced computer vision and deep learning algorithms, including contributions to released products. Proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). Deep understanding of image analysis methods such as segmentation, object detection, and classification, ideally within digital pathology (e.g., histopathology, tissue imaging) and/or spatial omics. Familiarity with large-scale data management and cloud-based computational environments. Strong communication and interpersonal skills Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in computational imaging, digital pathology, or medical image analysis. cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Associate Benefits — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate Benefits opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
